_about: ZONESCOPE v1 (kit fk_loadscope_kit). enabled false = today, bit for bit (every hook returns at once). enabled true: runtime-loaded GLBs (GlbPreload late tier, hub camp NPCs, ZoneHitch.Warm creature prefabs) are kept only for the CURRENT zone and neighbours[].keep; others are not parsed at start, staged ahead in calm frames, and dropped (GltfImport.Dispose) dropAfterS after the zone leaves scope. Files in no group stay always loaded. mbEst/mpx are decoded-size ESTIMATES from the GLB headers. v2: camps[] = the hub NPC sets are wanted only while the player is within aheadM before / behindM after the camp area (z1 never loads the hub), minAgeS after the scene load; hysteresisM before a camp is dropped; Defer skips any file already started (W7 double parse).

hitch._about: quietAfterArrivalS: no staged load starts in the first N s after a zone change (the arrival window the COO measures). arrivalBudgetMs: est ms of loader work allowed inside that window (0 = none). perPollBudgetMs: est ms of loads started per 0.25 s poll. calmFrameMs: the last frame must be shorter. spacingFrames: min frames between two starts. est ms = group mpx share x msPerMpx (4096x4096 PNG ~300 ms measured as one frame, cannot be sliced: so the budget is a placement budget, see README 6).

decode._about: ZoneDecode (README 9): mode uri = big GLB images (>= minPixels) get a uri and are decoded by Unity on a worker thread (UnityWebRequestTexture on a cache file) instead of LoadImage on the main thread. scope groups = only files of a zone_scope group, all = every GlbPreload parse. standalone = works with enabled false. Gate keys reused from hitch: calmFrameMs, holdWhileEngaged, maxWaitS; imageSpacingFrames = min frames between two image requests.
